scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run test && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/sendflow run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && node ./scripts/prepare-plesk-build.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:request-validation && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:landing-visibility && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:public-storage && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:origin-security && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:resend && pnpm --filter @workspace/sendflow run test:panel-access && pnpm --filter @workspace/sendflow run test:landing-countries && pnpm --filter @workspace/sendflow run test:seo
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
